_comment: Copy to mcp_servers.json and edit. This is the same shape Claude Desktop's
config uses, so an existing `mcpServers` block can be pasted straight in.
That asks each server what it offers and caches the schemas. Servers that
fail to start are reported and their tools are NOT offered to the agent.
Tools arrive namespaced as mcp__<server>__<tool>, so an external server can
never shadow a native tool like write_file and inherit its trust.
Every MCP call still passes the GPS-2 permission gate and the PRE_ACT hook,
exactly like a native tool. Grant filesystem or shell-capable servers the
same caution you would grant the House itself.
Set "disabled": true to keep a server declared but out of the agent's reach.
